name: Tempester 1.5.1.0 — bug fixes
summary: DSI 1.5.0.2 with its bug fixes only; nothing is added.

fixes: Sending or receiving a beat or a project no longer overwrites memory below the stack.
Sliders 2 to 4 react to pressure again for the real-time FX.
The compressor Peak Hold setting is kept with the sound, and the compressor envelope follows each beat you select.
A note length can be edited up to 255.
A SysEx import over USB is no longer disturbed by messages arriving on the DIN socket.
Play List: a one-step list no longer divides by zero, RT REC fills a step before moving on, and recording past the last step stops instead of writing outside the list.
The Loop screen no longer freezes in time signatures other than 4/4.

description: DSI Main 1.5.0.2 with the bug fixes only (patches n°2a-2c, 3, 4a, 4b, 5, 6, 7a-7c, 8); no function added. Voice, Panel and SAM unchanged.
